body.name: Global-selection algebraic handle
body.construction: Rotate signs so that \(B_{\eta,h}(x)=\begin{pmatrix}z&b_0\\c_0&d_0\end{pmatrix}\) with \(b_0,c_0,d_0>0\); combine \(t+u=z^2+b_0^2+c_0^2+d_0^2\), \(tu=(zd_0-b_0c_0)^2\), and \(z(t-u)=(1-c/t^2)\{z(t-d_0^2)+d_0b_0c_0\}\), then compare all stationary branches, spectral-edge junctions, and tails. At a separated tie, augment this branch comparison with the coefficient-indexed Gaussian singular-value process and the complete local nuisance-drift path.
